paragraphs.text: Halvor Arenson was the priest of the Kjeldoran village of Mikkel , during the Ice Age of Dominaria .
By 2934 AR , Halvor was not old, but he looked it. Harsh storms and the horrors of war had left him pale and gaunt, his hair thinning and his cheeks hollow. He leaned on a staff for balance.

Halvor took in the orphaned Kaysa as a ward of the church and his assistant. In 2934 AR, a great storm passed over the village of Mikkel, prohibiting its inhabitants from reaching the capital city of Krov to celebrate the Feast of Kjeld. Only Halvor and Kaysa reached the local church, intending to celebrate the feast anyway.

A group of three travelers reached the church: Lucilde Fiksdotter , Klazina Jansdotter , and Disa the Restless. Halvor offered them the bread he and Kaysa had prepared for the feast, while the three travelers recounted the horrors of their journey and how the legions of Lim-Dul seemed to be everywhere. During their conversation, the Elder Druid Kolbjörn joined the group at the church. Halvor seemed to be displeased by Kolbjörn's presence, as he felt that the druid had forsaken the nation of Kjeldor to live together with elves in Fyndhorn forest. When Kolbjörn announced that he had come to take Kaysa, who bore the mark of the Elder Druid, with him, Halvor replied that the child was a ward of the church and his protege, and that she was following the footsteps of Kjeld and not of Freyalise . Kolbjörn answered that he would respect Halvor's wish: as the church was going to be assaulted by the now undead villagers of Mikkel, Halvor would be killed, and Kolbjörn could then bring Kaysa to Fyndhorn.

Their argument was interrupted when the door was opened again by Avram Garrisson , a knight of the Order of Stromgald . Lucilde and Klazina were relieved to know that another knight had arrived to help them, until Avram revealed that he had allied himself with Lim-Dul, becoming undead, because he thought that Kjeldorans had become unworthy, allying themselves with elves and dwarves . When the hordes of the dead villagers broke into the church, Lucilde and Klazina, with the help of Disa, started to fight against them. Even Halvor fought against the dead, creating a disk of sunlight which he used to destroy the enemies. When the situation was hopeless, he realized that Kolbjörn and Kaysa were chanting the song of Freyalise . With the magic of the goddess, all the undead were stripped of their unholy life, thus saving the group. The next morning, Halvor confirmed that the villagers of Mikkel were dead. Kaysa announced to the priest that she would be heading with Kolbjörn to Fyndhorn, and Halvor, admitting the miracle he witnessed the night before, agreed to let them go.
